metas.name: Khalifa: The Ruler
metas.description: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

metas.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
metas.description: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

metas.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

metas.name: Unmadham
metas.description: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

metas.name: Balan - The Boy
metas.description: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

metas.name: I, Nobody
metas.description: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

metas.name: Secret of Kalinga
metas.description: A college sits on ancient Kalinga kingdom land. Behind it, a forest well holds a princess's spirit, imprisoned centuries ago. Students accidentally break the seal on New Year's Eve, triggering comedic chaos.

metas.name: Kattalan
metas.description: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

metas.name: Pallichattambi
metas.description: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. His mission to resist the Communist government takes a detour when he experiences an ideological awakening and falls in love with a comrade, sparking an epic tale of rebellion against feudal power and oppression.

metas.name: Thudakkam
metas.description: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

metas.name: Anomie
metas.description: Zaara, a relentless sister seeking answers in her brother's unresolved case, confronts a police officer after days of failed investigation. As faith in the system erodes, she pursues the truth on parallel paths, leading to a haunting revelation.

metas.name: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu
metas.description: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.

metas.name: Aroopi
metas.description: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.

metas.name: Chinna Chinna Aasai
metas.description: On the enchanting shores of Varanasi, two souls meet by chance. Somewhere within this unfolding chaos, an unspoken bond begins to form, slowly slipping beyond friendship.

metas.name: Varavu
metas.description: A family falls victim to the powerful elite in a small town. Time passes, wounds fester. One man's return forces a confrontation that will expose decades of lies and corruption.

metas.name: Ananthan Kaadu
metas.description: In a turbulent era of intense political unrest, four musical mercenaries rule over dangerous slums, whereupon they navigate complex power dynamics to survive a transformative period in history.

metas.name: Vivaah
metas.description: Vivaah revolves around four married couples as they navigate the chaotic challenges of modern relationships. From unexpected restrictions and arranged marriages to a wife's romantic longings amid a workaholic husband's neglect, the narrative follows four women fighting unique emotional battles in search of fulfilment and understanding.

metas.name: Uyir
metas.description: SI Ajeeb, a probationary officer posted in a Kerala town, investigates the mysterious death of an unidentified woman whose decomposed body is found in a well. Despite a lack of evidence and official support, he relentlessly pursues the truth with the help of ASI Joy while battling his own psychological struggles. Inspired by true events, the film follows his quest for justice in a case that changes his life forever.

metas.name: Abhirami
metas.description: Story about a young lady who lives in Dubai working as a nurse. She is very active on social media platforms. She becomes viral after a post on her social media account.

metas.name: Magic Mushrooms
metas.description: Haunted by childhood loss, a quiet young man from rural Idukki finds love with an introverted woman he meets by chance. When prejudice and misunderstanding threaten to separate them, a heartfelt public confession turns resistance into acceptance and leads them toward a hopeful future.

metas.name: Pluto
metas.description: Vicky, down on his luck after multiple failed businesses, accidentally befriends an alien named Pluto. Both considered losers, they navigate life together while a gang of thugs attempts to capture the alien.

metas.name: Maharaja Hostel
metas.description: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.

metas.name: Angam Attahasam
metas.description: Caught in the city's violent underworld, 24-year-old Ajay Chandran struggles between loyalty to his past and the will to survive. As enemies close in and allies betray, he fights to save his soul from the darkness consuming him.

metas.name: Anuraagam
metas.description: Anuraagam follows a college freshman who falls in love with a girl on his very first day on campus. What begins as an innocent attraction soon unfolds into a heartfelt journey of love, friendship, and self discovery.
